facts.fact: The minister of ICT and postal services told the 30th EACO Assemblies in Juba that the government is implementing the revised ICT Policy of 2012; the article gives no date for the remarks, so its published date is used.

The minister claimed the government is implementing the revised ICT Policy of 2012 and gave no figure or measure against its own targets; the article gives no date for the remarks, so its published date is used.
